rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card and dated predictions before data; synthetic on real masks (A1, binary and content) with two pre-data amendments; a post hoc A2 statistic and power check after the first run, labelled; replication on 70 units / 35 periods in three channels with variants (stall, untrimmed, gte); kick layer; 3 natives with dated predictions; confirm.py frozen, guarded, dry-run. Missing: holdout, per-call clock, regime-I power.
rationale.faithfulness: The mean-field Glauber relation is cleanly falsified where it can be tested: regime-III talk collective memory exceeds the prediction in every resolved period (#51 drho1 0.067 [0.034, 0.100]), content and kicks fail too. Regime-I consistency has no power (fast-field detection 0-6%). The talk statistic is post hoc. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: A cheap check (collective memory excess beside the equal-time dial) that flags when the dial reads a delayed interaction, and a lever caveat: nudge responses last about ten times longer than the agent clock predicts. Diagnostic, not a lever.

one_line: Fluctuations do not predict relaxation where talk coupling is real: regime-III collective talk outlives the mean-field Glauber prediction (#51 drho1 0.067 [0.034, 0.100]); kicks outlive it tenfold; content is a field.
